'''Staven Kremmos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was widely recognized as one of the finest minds on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. He was sent to [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] with a team of engineers to design the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] for [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]].<ref name="Starship article" />

==Behind the scenes==
Staven Kremmos is mentioned in an online article for ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'', a [[2001]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="Starship article" />
